Build a Python 3.11 standard-library-only command-line program with this exact behavior: read one JSON value from stdin; require it to be an array of strings; for every string trim surrounding whitespace and lowercase it; discard empty results; deduplicate; sort ascending; then write one compact JSON object to stdout with keys count and items, where count equals the number of normalized items.
